Name: (CP) Snow Goon Scarecrow
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=3][b]Updated for 1.6![/b][/size]

Tired of the classic Snowman Rarecrow? This mod replaces it with your very own Snow Goon Rarecrow! Make Sebastian's or Abigail's day with their very own Snow Goon on your farm, or raise up an army of Snow Goons yourself!

~~

[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and behold the mighty Snow Goon![/font]

Downloads.Description: Works in Stardew 1.6. Requires the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
